items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; Rapoport notes not expected to play, Adams has shown he can carry the load.
items.why: Hip/groin, not making great progress per McVay; doubtful listing and beat reports.
items.opportunity: Adams routes/targets spike without Nacua (prior 42% target rate on routes alone).

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; Rapoport notes positive longer-term news but Mariota starts.
items.why: Elbow, official out; good longer-term per Rapoport.
items.implication: Sit Daniels; Mariota starts, depresses WAS pass catchers somewhat.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring.
items.implication: Sit Collins; Schultz becomes primary TE target.
items.opportunity: Schultz saw 28% target share last week without Collins.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach says Warren will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury, official; Warren to lead per RB coach.
items.implication: Warren lead back with checkdown upside from Rodgers.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in despite questionable tags. Clarity hoped on Flowers, Mitchell, Moore.
items.why: ETR projections have them in as of now.
items.implication: Start if no further news; monitor early.

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Both active in committee; Coleman out removes depth.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expect checkdown spam from Rodgers as vertical game has failed. Projecting Warren in despite Q.
items.why: Coach quote on leading group; practice squad backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; high snap/route share expected.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Core muscle, IR expected; only 5 games in 3 seasons.

items.text: Davante Adams ran 142 routes without Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 42%; prior games without Puka: big production (e.g. 8-195-2).
items.implication: Adams WR1 lock if Nacua out.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim ceilings live; highest ever noted.
items.implication: Elite DFS tournament play / smash spot.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5, Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak Dallas run D, high prop.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games, RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util last week).
items.conflict: ETR lists Etienne IN but role still split.
